label: effectively overseen by natural persons
definition: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which they are in use.
source_quote: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way, including with appropriate human-machine interface tools, that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which they are in use.

label: measures identified and built... into the high-risk AI system
definition: The provider shall identify and build measures into the high-risk AI system before it is placed on the market or put into service, when technically feasible.
source_quote: measures identified and built, when technically feasible, into the high-risk AI system by the provider before it is placed on the market or put into service

label: measures identified... appropriate to be implemented by the deployer
definition: The provider shall identify measures before placing the high-risk AI system on the market or putting it into service that are appropriate to be implemented by the deployer.
source_quote: measures identified by the provider before placing the high-risk AI system on the market or putting it into service and that are appropriate to be implemented by the deployer.

label: natural persons... are enabled, as appropriate and proportionate
definition: The high-risk AI system shall be provided to the deployer in such a way that natural persons to whom human oversight is assigned are enabled, as appropriate and proportionate, to properly understand the relevant capacities and limitations of the high-risk AI system and be able to duly monitor its operation, including in view of detecting and addressing anomalies, dysfunctions and unexpected performance; to remain aware of the possible tendency of automatically relying or over-relying on the output produced by a high-risk AI system (automation bias), in particular for high-risk AI systems used to provide information or recommendations for decisions to be taken by natural persons; to correctly interpret the high-risk AI system’s output, taking into account, for example, the interpretation tools and methods available; to decide, in any particular situation, not to use the high-risk AI system or to otherwise disregard, override or reverse the output of the high-risk AI system; to intervene in the operation of the high-risk AI system or interrupt the system through a ‘stop’ button or a similar procedure that allows the system to come to a halt in a safe state.
source_quote: the high-risk AI system shall be provided to the deployer in such a way that natural persons to whom human oversight is assigned are enabled, as appropriate and proportionate:

label: identification has been separately verified and confirmed by at least two natural persons
definition: For high-risk AI systems referred to in point 1(a) of Annex III, no action or decision is taken by the deployer on the basis of the identification resulting from the system unless that identification has been separately verified and confirmed by at least two natural persons with the necessary competence, training and authority.
source_quote: no action or decision is taken by the deployer on the basis of the identification resulting from the system unless that identification has been separately verified and confirmed by at least two natural persons with the necessary competence, training and authority.
